20.The general rule of pleading is that the plaintiff of the suit is dominus litis and in that capacity has a right to choose who he wants to implead as defendants in the suit.
The plaintiff cannot ordinarily be compelled to implead a person as a party against whom he is not seeking any relief.

Order 1 Rule 10 , however, is an exception to this general rule and gives discretion to the court to implead such persons as may be necessary for just decision in the matter; such discretion can be exercised by the court on an application or suo moto.
CS(Comm.) No. 452/2018 Page 9 of 31 S.G.Polyplast Pvt. Ltd. Vs. VHL INC & Anr.

In the facts and circumstances, it is held that plaintiff has file the suit beyond the limitation; has not verified the suit as per law applicable to Commercial suits; and has also failed to prove that it is entitled for recovery of amount of cheque which was given by it to the defendants - as it has failed to prove that the cheque in fact was given for purchase of a car, which was not delivered to him.
The suit of plaintiff is therefore, dismissed.
